pr.body:
## Complete M10 touch drag and M11 short-viewport panels

PR1119 and PR1122 supplied the merged foundations. This continues existing PR1125 as exactly one work commit on merged M12bd96b2b1. Actual checklist/matrix conflicts required reconstruction. The independently updated remote95a23 was inspected before the leased update: all its M10 production and fixture bytes, merged Gallery index-status/selection work and concise sidebar copy are preserved.

### Resulting behavior

- A44px selected-items handle carries complete IDs/revisions through existing move operations; valid mounted folder/ancestor targets highlight and edge scrolling stays in the owning list. Invalid targets, second pointers, cancellation, scope changes and teardown clean up. Compatibility release clicks cannot activate replacement controls.
- Quick Access and saved-search44px reorder handles use existing full-order persistence/rollback. Tap/keyboard Move To and Up/Down remain available.
- Files keeps fixed Close and places fields plus unchanged Save/Clear actions in one bounded scroll region. Gallery removes compact sticky action positioning from its existing scroller and keeps fixed44px Close. Gallery navigation gets44px targets below900CSSpx independent of pointer type.
- At844×200/200%text, Files field space improves24→87.97px for a61px control; Gallery's63px field improves23→63px unobscured. Actions remain reachable by scrolling. No global bar/spacer, viewport metadata change, new state machine or transport is added.

### Evidence

Preserved M10 first-reds include long-press release opening replacement controls, sidebar53px displacement, native release-click failures18/21 and stationary late target8/9; the same reproducers pass. M11 preserves identical Files17 (16pass/1fail) and Gallery57 (52pass/5fail) before/after assertions. Selector and strict fixture-query mistakes are recorded separately and are not product defects.

Final local validation on production53177a7b (later edits only runner hash recording and documentation):

- Files135/135; Navigation162/162; Files panels22/22; Gallery panels57/57.
- Real built-Web drag49/49 and panels37/37, zero unexpected API/page/console errors. Active assets/index-BYQXNagw.js; both receipts record runner/build hashes.
- FullDesktop1594pass/0fail/1existing optional skip; typecheck and Web lint/build pass.
- Native helper21 reused with identical source. Eight actual VisualViewport scale/pan observations retained with explicit dependency comparison; these are not keyboard tests. Historical upstream80 is not counted as a new run.
- Independent integrated review found no remaining concrete blocker.

Exact hashes, complete checks, preserved first-reds and integration history are in docs/validation/mobile-files-touch-drag-2026-10-09.json and mobile-panels-short-viewport-2026-10-09.json. Canonical Files/Gallery/mobile docs and M49.V08/V09 are updated. All physical iOS/Android ordinary/installed, real keyboard/address bars/safe areas and screen-reader checks remain NOT RUN. The complete new PR CI is the merge gate; prior-head CI does not validate these M11 supplements.
